summary: Located in a modern development in this popular, & sought after Eden Valley village, well served for transport links & local amenities with popular primary school, a well presented, detached family home with flexible living space, 4 bedrooms, master ensuite, garage and private rear garden.
description:
Built in 2015 by popular local builders Story Homes, this beautifully presented family residence offers an outstanding opportunity to acquire a modern, low-maintenance home in the highly sought-after Eden Valley village of Lazonby.

Ideally positioned within easy walking distance of local shops, primary school, and the Carlisle–Settle railway line, the property combines village living with excellent connectivity.

The home is approached via ample off-road parking leading to an integral garage. The entrance hallway includes a cloakroom/WC and useful understairs storage. A bright front-facing living room provides a quiet reception space, while to the rear lies a superb open-plan dining kitchen, fitted with a comprehensive range of quality AEG appliances including dishwasher, hob, oven and fridge freezer, with space for dining and entertaining.

To the first floor are four well-proportioned bedrooms. The principal bedroom benefits from a stylish ensuite shower room and a range of built in Sharpes wardrobes, complemented by a contemporary four-piece family bathroom.

Externally, the rear garden has been thoughtfully landscaped, featuring established planting and a private patio seating area, ideal for outdoor entertaining and relaxation.

A superb turnkey home in a consistently sought-after location. Early viewing is strongly advised.

Directions From Penrith head north on the A6 for approximately 5 miles to Plumpton. Turn right at the crossroads signposted Lazonby. Once in Lazonby go down the hill taking the right-hand turn onto Scaur Lane and then the 2nd right into Meadow Close.

Services LPG powered central heating. Mains electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
